component.name: alibaba-kms
component.title: Alibaba Key Management Service (KMS)
component.description: Encrypt and decrypt data using Alibaba Cloud Key Management Service (KMS).
component.label: cloud

lazyStartProducer.label: producer
lazyStartProducer.description: Whether the producer should be started lazy (on the first message). By starting lazy you can use this to allow CamelContext and routes to startup in situations where a producer may otherwise fail during starting and cause the route to fail being started. By deferring this startup to be lazy then the startup failure can be handled during routing messages via Camel's routing error handlers. Beware that when the first message is processed then creating and starting the producer may take a little time and prolong the total processing time of the processing.

autowiredEnabled.label: advanced
autowiredEnabled.description: Whether autowiring is enabled. This is used for automatic autowiring options (the option must be marked as autowired) by looking up in the registry to find if there is a single instance of matching type, which then gets configured on the component. This can be used for automatic configuring JDBC data sources, JMS connection factories, AWS Clients, etc.

healthCheckConsumerEnabled.label: health
healthCheckConsumerEnabled.description: Used for enabling or disabling all consumer based health checks from this component

healthCheckProducerEnabled.label: health
healthCheckProducerEnabled.description: Used for enabling or disabling all producer based health checks from this component. Notice: Camel has by default disabled all producer based health-checks. You can turn on producer checks globally by setting camel.health.producersEnabled=true.

CamelAlibabaKmsOperation.label: producer
CamelAlibabaKmsOperation.description: The operation that the producer performs, which replaces the operation of the endpoint. If this header is not set, an exchange property of the same name replaces it.

CamelAlibabaKmsKeyId.label: producer
CamelAlibabaKmsKeyId.description: The ID, alias or ARN of the KMS key for encrypt and generateDataKey. This header replaces the keyId option. If this header is not set, an exchange property of the same name replaces the keyId option.

CamelAlibabaKmsPlaintext.label: producer
CamelAlibabaKmsPlaintext.description: The plaintext for encrypt. The producer encodes it in UTF-8 and sends it to KMS in Base64. This header replaces the plaintext option. If this header is not set, an exchange property of the same name replaces the plaintext option. A Map or a POJO fails, as it does in the message body, since Camel reads it only as its toString().

CamelAlibabaKmsCiphertextBlob.label: producer
CamelAlibabaKmsCiphertextBlob.description: The ciphertext blob for decrypt, for example from the response to encrypt or generateDataKey. This header replaces the ciphertextBlob option. If this header is not set, an exchange property of the same name replaces the ciphertextBlob option.

CamelAlibabaKmsKeySpec.label: producer
CamelAlibabaKmsKeySpec.description: The key spec of the data key for generateDataKey. The value must be AES_256 or AES_128. KMS does not use it when the number of bytes is set as well. This header replaces the keySpec option. If this header is not set, an exchange property of the same name replaces the keySpec option.

CamelAlibabaKmsNumberOfBytes.label: producer
CamelAlibabaKmsNumberOfBytes.description: The number of bytes of the data key for generateDataKey. The value must be from 1 to 1024. This header replaces the numberOfBytes option. If this header is not set, an exchange property of the same name replaces the numberOfBytes option. Only generateDataKey reads it, and a value that is not a number fails that operation alone.

CamelAlibabaKmsRequestId.label: producer
CamelAlibabaKmsRequestId.description: The request ID that KMS returns in the response to the operation. The producer sets it, unless the exchange fails.

producerIn.description: encrypt encrypts the body unless the plaintext option or header is set: text in UTF-8, bytes as they are, and a stream or a file as its bytes, so binary data is kept. A Map or a POJO fails, as it does not convert to bytes, so marshal it first. decrypt takes the ciphertext blob as text, unless the ciphertextBlob option or header is set. No body fails both; generateDataKey does not use the body

producerOut.description: A Map with the statusCode and the fields of the response: the ciphertextBlob and keyId of encrypt, the plaintext of decrypt, which is Base64 when this component encrypted it, and the plaintext and ciphertextBlob of generateDataKey. The request id is in the CamelAlibabaKmsRequestId header too

operation.label: producer
operation.description: The operation that the producer performs. The CamelAlibabaKmsOperation header replaces this option for a request that the producer sends. If that header is not set, an exchange property of the same name replaces this option.

endpoint.description: The endpoint of KMS, which is a host name without http:// or https://. The producer sends requests to it over HTTPS. If not set, the region option determines the endpoint, and one of the two is required. Not used when the kmsClient option is set or autowired.

keyId.description: The ID, alias or ARN of the KMS key for encrypt and generateDataKey. The CamelAlibabaKmsKeyId header replaces this option for a request that the producer sends. If that header is not set, an exchange property of the same name replaces this option. One of the three is required for encrypt and generateDataKey.

keySpec.description: The key spec of the data key for generateDataKey. The value must be AES_256 or AES_128. KMS does not use it when the number of bytes is set as well. The CamelAlibabaKmsKeySpec header replaces this option for a request that the producer sends. If that header is not set, an exchange property of the same name replaces this option. If none of the three is set, the producer adds no key spec to the request.

numberOfBytes.description: The number of bytes of the data key for generateDataKey. The value must be from 1 to 1024. The CamelAlibabaKmsNumberOfBytes header replaces this option for a request that the producer sends. If that header is not set, an exchange property of the same name replaces this option. If none of the three is set, the producer adds no number of bytes to the request.

region.description: The region ID of KMS, for example cn-hangzhou. Only used when the endpoint option is not set, to build the endpoint of KMS. One of the two is required, unless the kmsClient option is set or autowired, which uses neither.

lazyStartProducer.label: producer,advanced
lazyStartProducer.description: Whether the producer should be started lazy (on the first message). By starting lazy you can use this to allow CamelContext and routes to startup in situations where a producer may otherwise fail during starting and cause the route to fail being started. By deferring this startup to be lazy then the startup failure can be handled during routing messages via Camel's routing error handlers. Beware that when the first message is processed then creating and starting the producer may take a little time and prolong the total processing time of the processing.

kmsClient.label: advanced
kmsClient.description: To use a custom com.aliyun.kms20160120.Client. The producer sends its requests with this client, and the region, endpoint, accessKey, secretKey and serviceKeys options are not used. If no client is set or autowired, the Camel endpoint creates a client from these options. It creates this client when the producer processes its first message.

accessKey.label: security
accessKey.description: The AccessKey ID of the AccessKey pair for the requests that the producer sends to KMS. If not set, the accessKey of the serviceKeys option is used, and one of the two is required. Not used when the kmsClient option is set or autowired.

ciphertextBlob.label: security
ciphertextBlob.description: The ciphertext blob for decrypt, for example from the response to encrypt or generateDataKey. The CamelAlibabaKmsCiphertextBlob header replaces this option for a request that the producer sends. If that header is not set, an exchange property of the same name replaces this option. If none of the three is set, the producer takes the ciphertext blob from the message body as text.

plaintext.label: security
plaintext.description: The plaintext for encrypt. The producer encodes it in UTF-8 and sends it to KMS in Base64. The CamelAlibabaKmsPlaintext header replaces this option for a request that the producer sends. If that header is not set, an exchange property of the same name replaces this option. If none of the three is set, the producer takes the plaintext from the message body.

secretKey.label: security
secretKey.description: The AccessKey secret of the AccessKey pair for the requests that the producer sends to KMS. If not set, the secretKey of the serviceKeys option is used, and one of the two is required. Not used when the kmsClient option is set or autowired.

serviceKeys.label: security
serviceKeys.description: The AccessKey pair as an org.apache.camel.component.alibaba.common.models.ServiceKeys. Its accessKey is the AccessKey ID and its secretKey is the AccessKey secret. Each of the two is used when the option of the same name is not set. Not used when the kmsClient option is set or autowired.
